name: VoiceBench
description: VoiceBench is the first benchmark designed to evaluate the speech interaction capabilities of LLM-based voice assistants in real-world scenarios, incorporating diverse speaker characteristics, environmental conditions, and content variations. It includes both real and synthetic spoken instructions to provide a multi-faceted assessment beyond traditional ASR and clean speech evaluations.
reputation: A recent benchmark for voice assistants that has been cited as an early attempt to evaluate real-world speech interaction beyond ASR.
notes: Addresses real-world speech interaction challenges; reveals limitations of current LLM-based voice assistants.
